import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the sanitized content. BLOG_FORMAT: str = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Formats a blog post for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The headline or title of the blog post. post_body : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- * The function uses ``html.escape`` to escape any characters that could form malicious HTML or JavaScript when rendered in a browser. * The resulting string is safe to embed directly into an HTML document without further escaping. """ # Sanitize title and body to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert sanitized content into the template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
